product_quality_learning.cause: A descendant span selector applied chip padding, border and background to the nested icon span.
product_quality_learning.solution: Scope chip styles to direct children and preserve the dedicated icon rule.
product_quality_learning.preventive_rule: Nested trust icons must never inherit chip padding, border or background.

product_quality_learning.cause: A shared realtime safe_message and a fixed Live label exposed DB/cache/render details to clients.
product_quality_learning.solution: Use outcome-focused client copy while retaining explicit technical diagnostics in admin mode.
product_quality_learning.preventive_rule: Client copy explains availability and freshness; DB/cache/render terminology remains admin-only.

product_quality_learning.cause: Machine ISO timestamps were reused as client-facing copy by shared macros and polling.
product_quality_learning.impact: Raw technical dates reduce readability and weaken the explicit Madrid-time promise.
product_quality_learning.solution: Derive one Madrid label while preserving the original ISO in APIs, datetime attributes and technical admin mode.
product_quality_learning.preventive_rule: Client sync dates use the canonical Madrid label; raw ISO remains machine/admin evidence only.

product_quality_learning.cause: Calendar context can regress when a consumer recalculates data or drops persistent navigation layers.
product_quality_learning.impact: Users lose date, filter or scroll context and need more effort to locate a match.
product_quality_learning.solution: Keep page and API on one V940 snapshot, one canonical match card and local-only context restoration.
product_quality_learning.preventive_rule: Calendar consumers use v940_calendar_context over sports-metrics-v1; navigation layers and the canonical match card remain present.
